# Returns and refunds

Northwind Outfitters accepts returns of unused items within 30 calendar days of
delivery. Keep the original tags attached and include the order number. Clothing
must be clean and unworn. Final-sale items cannot be returned for a change of mind;
damaged or incorrect items follow the separate damaged-items policy.

## Start a return

Contact Northwind support with your order number and the item you want to return.
Support provides a return authorization and label instructions. Do not send an item
back before receiving that authorization. Standard change-of-mind return postage
costs 5 dollars, deducted from the refund. Northwind covers return postage when it
sent a damaged or incorrect item.

## Refund timing

Warehouse inspection takes 3 business days after the returne

takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch and costs 6 dollars. Standard shipping is
free when the merchandise subtotal after discounts is at least 75 dollars. Express
shipping takes 1 to 2 business days after dispatch and costs 15 dollars.

not include that processing time, weekends or public holidays. A tracking link is
emailed after the carrier receives the parcel; the first tracking scan can take
24 hours to appear. Check spam if the dispatch email is missing.

# Product warranty and wear

Northwind provides a one-year limited warranty for manufacturing defects from the
purchase date. Keep proof of purchase and contact support with the order number,
photos and a description of the defect. The warranty review may result in repair,
replacement or another resolution after a human assessment.

## What is excluded

Normal wear, accidental tears, misuse, unauthorized alterations and damage caused
by ignoring care instructions are not manufacturing defects. The warranty is not
a lifetime replacement promise. A defect reported outside the ordinary return
window can still be reviewed under the warranty if it is within the one-year period.

# Cancelling an order

A Northwind order may be cancelled within one hour of purchase if it has not been
dispatched. Contact support immediately with your order number. Support must check
the current order status before confirming a cancellation; sending a request alone
does not guarantee that it succeeded.

returns process if the item is eligible. Do not promise a cancellation when tracking
already shows carrier acceptance. Cancellation and refund processing are separate

# Size and color exchanges

Northwind does not process direct exchanges. If an unused item has its original
tags and is within the 30-day return window, start an authorized return and place
a separate order for the desired size or color. The new order uses current prices
and available stock; support cannot reserve stock while waiting for a return.

## Costs and exceptions

A change-of-mind return has the normal 5-dollar return postage deduction. Shipping
for the replacement purchase follows the shipping policy. A sale price from the
original purchase is not automatically transferred. If Northwind sent the wrong
size or color, report it under damaged and incorrect items instead; Northwind then
covers approved return postage.

# Gift cards and gift returns

Northwind digital gift cards are emailed to the recipient after payment is confirmed.
They do not expire and are redeemable only at Northwind checkout. A remaining
balance stays on the card for a future purchase. Gift cards cannot be exchanged
for cash and cannot be used to buy another gift card.

## Returning a gift

An eligible gift return needs a gift receipt or the original order number and must
meet the normal unused-with-tags 30-day return requirement. The recipient receives
store credit; Northwind does not send the recipient a refund to somebody else's
card. The purchaser may request an original-payment refund through support instead.
